description: This file defines the HttpMethodNotAllowedException class within the Slim framework, specifically for handling HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed errors. The class extends a specialized exception and manages allowed HTTP methods, message construction, and exception details.

classes.name: HttpMethodNotAllowedException
classes.description: An exception class representing HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed errors, allowing setting and retrieving allowed HTTP methods.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of allowed HTTP methods for the request.

methods.name: setAllowedMethods
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed HTTP methods and updates the exception message accordingly.
